name: Non-Title IX Discrimination Investigative Report (Employment)
description: Written report summarizing the investigation, whether the complaint is substantiated, the basis for the finding, and any policy or legal violations.
recipient: Title IX Coordinator or Superintendent's designee
deadline: within 30 business days after the investigator receives the complaint, unless a different due date is set
quote: The investigator shall prepare and submit a written report to the Title IX Coordinator or Superintendent’s designee within thirty (30) business days after the investigator receives a copy of the complaint
